answer_1.quote: Paragraph generation is an important yet challenging task... Typical paragraph generation tasks include story generation, news generation, scientific paper generation...

answer_2.quote: We use metrics introduced in previous work to evaluate accuracy and diversity. Top-1 metric (⇑) ... BLEU, METEOR, CIDEr. Diversity (Dist-2, Self-B-4, Entropy-4).

answer_4.quote: We sample 100 inputs from ROCStories test set and each evaluated method generates top-3 stories. Every story is assigned to five annotators with NLP background... annotators give an accuracy score from 1 to 5... fluency and coherency score from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two sets of generated stories for diversity, rate accuracy (semantic similarity) on a 1-5 scale, and rate fluency and coherency on a 1-5 scale.
